annotations.title: Draft a job application (Bewerbung) by email

description: Use this when the user wants to apply for one of their matched jobs (Bewerbung). Drafts an application by email for that job: recipient from the posting, subject, cover letter and the stored resume document as attachment. Sends nothing. Show the user the draft, let them edit the cover letter and sign it with their name. If the posting asks for more (salary expectation, earliest start date, a cover letter, certificates), forderungen names each with a hint for the user; the cover letter then holds a line with [bitte eintragen] that must be filled in or removed before sending. If the posting names no email address for applications, the call is refused and names the posting. Scope: cv:lesen.
name: draft_job_application
title: Draft a job application (Bewerbung) by email
